title: Human Resource Operations Lead
description:
Urgent Hiring Site Manager HR | Mundra, Gujarat 
 Company: Sodexo India Services Pvt. Ltd.
 Position: Site Manager – HR
 Job Location: Mundra, Gujarat
 Department: Human Resources
 Reporting To: Site Manager / Unit Manager
 Experience: 4+ Years
 Qualification: Graduate
 Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Preferred 
 Key Responsibilities Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements and company HR policies at the client site. Manage end-to-end HR operations and employee relations at the site. Coordinate with Branch Office and Head Office for employee training and development initiatives. Handle recruitment and selection of contractual and permanent employees within stipulated timelines. Coordinate with clients regularly and resolve employee-related issues promptly. Ensure timely salary processing and payment for all employees deployed at the site. Manage contractual manpower, workforce planning and staffing requirements. Handle industrial relations (IR) matters and provide necessary HR guidance to the operations team. Implement employee engagement, welfare, reward and recognition initiatives. Promote diversity, equal employment opportunities and a positive work environment. Monitor manpower budgets and ensure staffing activities are aligned with company policies. Manage, motivate and develop the HR team through effective performance management. 
 Required Skills Strong knowledge of Labour Laws and Statutory Compliance. Contract Labour Management. Industrial Relations (IR). HR Operations and Employee Relations. Contractual and Permanent Manpower Management. Client and Stakeholder Management. Recruitment and Workforce Planning. Salary Processing and Employee Welfare. Negotiation and Conflict Resolution Skills. Excellent Communication and Interpersonal Skills. 
 Educational Qualification Graduate in any discipline. Minimum 4+ years of relevant HR experience. Experience in Facility Management / IFM / Manufacturing / Industrial sectors will be preferred. 
 Candidate Requirements Candidates should be available to join immediately. Willingness to work at the client site in Mundra, Gujarat. Strong interpersonal, negotiation and problem-solving abilities. 
 Interested Candidates share your updated resume at: 
 Email: vim.shaw@sodexo.com
 Contact: 9073923508 
 Contact Person: Vim Kumar Shaw
 HR Assistant Manager
 Sodexo India Services Pvt. Ltd.
